data.name: Maternal Health Risk
data.abstract: Data has been collected from different hospitals, community clinics, maternal health cares from the rural areas of Bangladesh through the IoT based risk monitoring system.

intro_paper.title: Review and Analysis of Risk Factor of Maternal Health in Remote Area Using the Internet of Things (IoT)
intro_paper.authors: Marzia Ahmed, M. A. Kashem, Mostafijur Rahman, S. Khatun
intro_paper.venue: Lecture Notes in Electrical Engineering, vol 632

variables.name: Age
variables.description: Any ages in years when a women during pregnant.

variables.name: SystolicBP
variables.description: Upper value of Blood Pressure in mmHg, another significant attribute during pregnancy.

variables.name: DiastolicBP
variables.description: Lower value of Blood Pressure in mmHg, another significant attribute during pregnancy.

variables.name: BS
variables.description: Blood glucose levels is in terms of a molar concentration

variables.name: RiskLevel
variables.description: Predicted Risk Intensity Level during pregnancy considering the previous attribute.

additional_info.summary: Age, Systolic Blood Pressure as SystolicBP, Diastolic BP as DiastolicBP, Blood Sugar as BS, Body Temperature as BodyTemp, HeartRate and RiskLevel. All these are the responsible and significant risk factors for maternal mortality, that is one of the main concern of SDG of UN.
